1.consolidated_definition: Planta epifita de hasta 2 m de longitud, de tallo flexible, hojas largas, delgadas, curvadas o arremolinadas, de color gris, y flores muy pequeñas en espiga, de color verde pálido o azul; se emplea como estropajo y para hacer adornos navideños. (Bromeliaceae; Tillandsia usneoides).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Epiphytic plant reaching up to 2 m in length, with a flexible stem, long and thin leaves that are curved or rolled, gray in color, and small flowers in a spike, pale green or blue in color; it is used as a scrubber and for making Christmas decorations (Bromeliaceae; Tillandsia usneoides).
